basics.name: Jatin Avinash Salve
basics.label: AI Systems Performance Engineer | LLM Inference | GPU Profiling & Optimization
basics.summary: M.S. Computer Science student at the University of Florida (GPA 3.89) focused on LLM inference, KV-cache behavior, benchmarking, and distributed GPU systems. Production ML engineer and ACL 2024 long-paper author working across Python, C++, PyTorch, and CUDA.

work.name: University of Florida College of Medicine
work.position: Research Assistant — AI Systems, LLM Evaluation & Infrastructure
work.summary: Building reproducible clinical LLM evaluation infrastructure on UF HiPerGator.
highlights: Built LLM experimentation infrastructure with Slurm, Apptainer, Python, Neo4j, and Graphiti for reproducible runs and persistent graph memory.
Benchmarked direct, long-context, vanilla RAG, time-aware RAG, hierarchical, rolling-memory, and graph temporal-memory summarization.
Built a six-stage verification pipeline for temporal Graphiti and Neo4j memory, evaluated against 1,682 hand-audited atomic facts.
Contributed to a permission-aware React, TypeScript, and FastAPI application with retrieval, validation, structured logs, Docker, ECS, and CloudWatch.

work.name: ICICI Bank Pvt Limited
work.position: Machine Learning Engineer — Production ML Systems
work.summary: Built and operated production inference and ranking systems serving more than one million daily requests.
highlights: Built FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, and ECS inference services; improved p95 latency by 5% through feature retrieval and serving optimizations.
Developed feature-store ranking and propensity workflows that increased click-through rate by 9%.
Owned preprocessing, retraining, deployment, rollback, CI/CD, integration testing, telemetry, and production debugging.
Built Python A/B and performance analyses across latency, throughput, relevance, conversion, and customer cohorts.

work.name: IIT Patna AI-ML-NLP Lab
work.summary: Developed and evaluated multimodal encoder-decoder systems for clinical document summarization.
highlights: Extended BART with image fusion and decoder cross-attention.
Benchmarked three datasets against BART, GPT-4V, and multimodal baselines using ROUGE, BLEU, METEOR, statistics, and expert review.
Profiled ResNet, VGG, ViT, and fusion choices; documented failures and ablations for an ACL 2024 long paper.

work.name: Google Summer of Code — Joomla CMS
work.summary: Developed the Guided Tour feature in Joomla 4 core for a platform used by 2M+ users.
highlights: Worked across MVC architecture, plugins, testing, code review, and documentation, then returned as an open-source mentor.

publications.name: From Sights to Insights: Towards Summarization of Multimodal Clinical Documents
publications.summary: Multimodal clinical document summarization with image fusion, decoder cross-attention, and extensive evaluation.

publications.name: Structure-Grounded Retrieval and Claim Verification
publications.summary: Faithful generation through structured retrieval and claim-level verification.

projects.name: Latency-Aware Speculative Decoding & Draft-Model Distillation
projects.summary: Built a correct speculative decoding engine with drafting, verification, rejection correction, bonus tokens, and KV caching; verified exact greedy equivalence.
highlights: Reduced 64 target passes to 22 verification passes and reached 2.91 tokens per target pass.
Profiled 0.79x–1.09x performance versus greedy decoding and found the draft model consumed 62% of GPU time.
Improved cached greedy throughput from 92.96 to 102.06 tokens/s; distillation improved acceptance by 5% on GSM8K and 4% on CNN/DailyMail.

projects.name: Verifiable Preference Optimization for Reasoning LLMs
projects.summary: Generated 1,800 verified reasoning traces and 330 preference pairs for LoRA DPO with Hugging Face TRL.
highlights: Established a 61–63 generated tokens/s baseline on NVIDIA L4.
Diagnosed truncation and answer-parsing label noise and redesigned validation for reliable evaluation.
